Name: Immersive Event Endings
Author: MasterRoshiHEHE
Description:
I heard you guys are loving the new influx of AI generated SMAPI mods, so I thought I'd take a crack at it and try and fix a thing that always bothered me in vanilla SDV.

[center][size=5][b]Immersive Event Endings[/b][/size]
[i]The Turtle Hermit's Footprint Fix![/i][/center]
[line]

Greetings, young farmers! Master Roshi here. When I'm not busy... er, "observing" the lovely ladies down at the Ginger Island resort, I've been noticing something strange about the way things work in your little valley!

[size=4][b]The Problem[/b][/size]
You ever finish a nice, long cutscene or an event, and suddenly—POOF!—you're teleported all the way back to the entrance of the map? It breaks the immersion! One second you are having a deep, meaningful moment right in the middle of town, and the next you are standing at the bus stop! It makes an old man dizzy, I tell ya!

[size=4][b]What this mod does[/b][/size]
This mod uses a little martial arts magic to fix your footing. When a cutscene ends, it reads your exact X and Y coordinates. Instead of throwing you to the edge of the map, it anchors you. You will load back into the normal game [b]standing right where you were[/b] when the event finished.

[list]
[*][b]Player Only (For Safety!):[/b] Right now, this only works for YOU. I thought about doing it for the townsfolk, but event maps are tricky! The youngsters kept getting stuck inside bushes or walking into walls when the event ended. It was a disaster! So, to keep your game safe, NPCs will just go back to their normal routines like they always do.[/*]
[*][b]Seamless Storytelling:[/b] Makes your events feel like they actually happened right there in the world. [/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and extract the ZIP file.[/*]
[*]Toss that folder right into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[*]Fire up the game and enjoy your newfound balance![/*]
[/list]


[line]
[url=https://github.com/MasterRoshiHehe/ImmersiveEventEndings]Link to the source code[/url]
Now, if you'll excuse me, I need to go see if Haley needs any help applying her sunscreen. Heh heh heh!

Manifest.Description: Modifies event endings to position the player at their current location instead of default positions.
